name: a re-review raises no new clauses in unchanged text, but catches a reworded one (#160)
prompt: Re-review a `spec:` PR, following .sdlc/REVIEW.md exactly, including clause coverage and its rules for a re-review. The PR's repo is the git repo in ./rereview (run git there with `git -C rereview …`), its spec is rereview/changes/0001-hero-docs/spec.md at HEAD, and the intent counts as merged. An earlier review of this PR posted one thread; it's in rereview/earlier-threads.json, exactly as `gh api repos/<repo>/pulls/<N>/comments` returns it, so read that file wherever REVIEW.md says to call gh. Don't use GitHub or the network. Write each finding to findings.md in the current directory (beside rereview/, not inside it), one finding per `## ` heading, quoting the text it is about, as .sdlc/REVIEW.md's Writing findings section says, and start each finding's body with its severity as Posting findings says (`**Important (product owner decides):**` or `**Nit:**`). Don't edit any other file.
